title: Tri-Runtime Cloud Consolidation
objective: Consolidar OpenAI Cloud, Claude Code Cloud e Antigravity local em uma única arquitetura R1-R9 com GitHub como plano de controle.
human_gates: Connect GitHub repository to Claude Code web and authorize Routines.
Configure Claude unattended connectors with project-scoped read-only Supabase only.
Connect repository to Codex Cloud and enable review settings if desired.
Map and smoke-test the six physical Antigravity agents against R1-R9.
Independent R6 review before merge to main.
